focused_unit_tests.scope: Source, parser and metrology rejection controls; native controls are counted separately.

original_failure: Original W8 source mirror had approximately23 percent zero-phase integrated charge mismatch. Exact native wave/circuit retained in public pilot03; chosen W6.4 is the sole pump geometry change.
limitations: 100MHz nominal 2.5V/27C/TT finite80ns standalone primitive; no PVT, mismatch, jitter, noise, layout, aging, foundry SOA or closed-loop qualification.
All terminal pairs3.3V and peak drain current2mA/um are project development screens, not foundry SOA acceptance.
Finite native RC load control acceptance is only the20..70ns window mean0.9..1.5V; it is not an all-time compliance clamp.
The20ps/10ps comparison is limited measurement sensitivity, not general solver convergence.
Zero-phase charge matching does not imply equal pump gain: nominal+2ns and-2ns produce approximately+7.540 and-9.268uA; the measured nonzero-error asymmetry is retained.
External full-swing clock/reset/supply and DC control clamps are measurement sources; no internal ideal DUT gate/current/delay/clock exists.
Pump sources for REF lead; the frozen VCO has negative tuning gain, requiring reversed loop polarity before any integration.
No8GHz divide80 feedback, loop filter, lock detection, reference receiver, power sequencing or main-chip connection implemented here.
